title: Cancer omics: subtype transfer, prognosis and network-state evidence
question: How should a new cancer cohort be used for molecular subtyping, prognostic scoring, network-state analysis or immunotherapy-response assessment?
scope: A source-linked worked comparison and reusable reporting worksheet for choosing analyses in a new cancer cohort. Six examples separate molecular subtyping, survival prognosis, stage-associated network states and treatment-response evidence, using reviewed study facts and identified methodological guidance.
reading_rule: Start with the intended output, cohort and observation unit. Then identify the model/template/network object, its implementation and updating, independent evaluation data, endpoint/time and response measurements. Keep the separate analyses of one publication in separate worksheet rows and cite the original DOI for study findings.

research_use.question: Which analysis and evidence should be carried into a new external cancer cohort?
research_use.question_zh: 为新的外部癌症队列选择分析时，应迁移什么对象，怎样报告其验证证据？
research_use.answer: Define the output first. HCCcrds provides a molecular-subtype and cohort-role example; the thyroid study separates a stage-associated DNB state from a compact subtype classifier; LPAS contributes a retrospective survival-score example; the TNBC work distinguishes molecular-state profiling, a mixed-cancer response-model pipeline and target-cancer proxy analyses. ConsensusClusterPlus can assess resampling stability, and SubMap can assess molecular correspondence across independently defined subclasses. For prediction models, record unchanged implementation versus updating/refitting. For treatment claims, identify actual outcome-linked response data separately from molecular proxies. The worksheet makes these choices explicit before a new-cohort analysis.
research_use.answer_zh: 先确定所需输出。HCCcrds提供分子亚型及队列用途的实例；甲状腺研究区分分期相关DNB网络状态与紧凑亚型分类器；LPAS提供回顾性生存风险评分实例；TNBC研究则需分开分子状态、混合癌种响应模型和目标癌种中的预测proxy。ConsensusClusterPlus可评估重采样下的聚类稳定性，SubMap可评估独立数据中既定亚类的分子对应。对预测模型，记录是否原样应用、更新或重拟合；对治疗主张，另列真实结局关联响应数据。工作表用于在新队列分析前明确这些选择。

checklist.text: Record the intended molecular label, survival endpoint, network-state output or treatment response; identify independent patients/specimens and development/model-selection overlap.

Use consensus stability to inspect robustness under subsampling and subclass mapping to inspect cross-dataset correspondence. Report the data, labels/features and method settings for the task actually performed.
For a prognostic or response model, retain the model version, features/weights, preprocessing and any change or refit. Record assessment on data separate from development and selection.
For survival, state endpoint, time origin, horizon, follow-up and censoring. For stage/network analysis, state the stage/reference groups and whether observations are cross-sectional or longitudinal.

Name the cancer, treatment, sampling time and response definition when measured. Otherwise report the named immune score, expression mapping or predicted group, and keep it separate from observed benefit.
Use the existing HCC worked example and five-dataset CSV for Fig.5A/B membership. This comparison adds output/implementation/reporting roles rather than another accession roster.

research_use.comparison_note: Use these rows for applicability and reporting, rather than to rank unlike performance measures. The original methods establish resampling stability and cross-dataset subclass correspondence as positive capabilities. Requiring measured outcome-linked evidence for a clinical or response claim is this resource's task-based inference, not a statement that those method authors reject clinical applications. External-validation guidance is applied here to prediction models, not as a universal clustering criterion.

research_uses.text: Select the intended output and fill one blank row for each cohort/model/endpoint. Identify the original artifact and distinguish unchanged application, adaptation/refit, new clustering/network construction and observed-response assessment before running the analysis.

Carry the source version, exact locator, actual data role, implementation changes and unresolved details into the manuscript. Use the omics review for narrative methodological context and the primary studies for their empirical claims; this new comparison does not imply the older review cited the later studies.

research_uses.use: Clinical models: compare endpoints and validation
research_uses.text: Compare postoperative models by endpoint, horizon and validation setting. RAP-AIscore assessed overall survival after robot-assisted proctectomy; in its independent retrospective SYEMH cohort, 1-, 2- and 3-year AUCs were 0.587, 0.754 and 0.810. ALRITE modeled three-year local recurrence using an approximately 10% within-dataset holdout. Its highest reported AUC, 0.76, came from an analysis with oversampling in both training/testing and validation. These values do not establish comparative superiority: endpoints and evaluation designs differ, and each AUC must retain its stated horizon. The robotic-versus-laparoscopic study's available abstract reports multivariable Cox associations with overall and disease-free survival; it does not report individual prediction performance. For a Methods or Discussion comparison, distinguish independent-hospital evaluation from a held-out subset of the same dataset.

task_workspace.title: Choose and report an analysis for a new external cancer cohort
task_workspace.intro: Use one row per analysis, cohort, model version and endpoint. Record the output before selecting a method. Split subtype assignment, survival prognosis, network state and treatment response into their actual roles. NR means unresolved in this extraction, not that the original paper omitted a detail. For a new cohort, report the artifact, preprocessing, every adaptation/refit, independence, endpoint/time and available treatment labels; use the blank CSV to retain those decisions.

decisions.text: Choose molecular subtype, prognostic risk, a group/network state or observed response before evaluating a new dataset. State the observation unit, reference labels and the particular analysis supported by each cohort.

decisions.rule: Use stability and correspondence for their positive tasks
decisions.text: ConsensusClusterPlus supplies repeated-subsampling stability and membership evidence. SubMap tests correspondence between previously defined subclasses across independently generated datasets. The reporting inference is that a stability plot or molecular association matrix alone does not supply clinical outcomes that were not measured; the original SubMap paper also includes separate prediction and survival analyses.

For a prognostic or response predictor, identify the original model/feature/weight artifact and document any recalibration, coefficient/cutoff refit or retraining, with its development and assessment data. This prediction-model guidance is not used to judge unsupervised clustering as though it were a fixed clinical risk model.

decisions.rule: Keep stage-associated states separate from patient time
decisions.text: The thyroid DNB comparison is cross-sectional and stage-associated. Reconstructing its network/state output and applying miniPC subtype labels are distinct analyses; neither supplies an observed within-patient transition time merely from stage membership.

decisions.rule: Identify the response evidence actually present
decisions.text: Record treatment, pretreatment sampling, cancer and measured response when available. Distinguish mixed-cancer source-data evaluation from a new cancer-specific response cohort. IPS/TIDE, predicted-response groups and SubMap molecular correspondence retain their actual computational roles.

decisions.rule: Reuse the existing HCC cohort-role table
decisions.text: For HCC Fig.5A subtype versus Fig.5B survival membership, follow the existing worked example and CSV. Do not recreate its dataset list in this resource. Keep cross-study metric ranking unset when tasks, endpoint/time definitions or implementations differ.
